nodes.name: documentedField
nodes.documentation: A documented field.

nodes.name: genericMethodWithTypeParameterShadowingClassParameter
nodes.documentation: The method's own T hides the class's T.

nodes.name: virtualMethodWithDefaultBody
nodes.documentation: Re-abstracts an inherited concrete method.

nodes.name: first
nodes.documentation: Re-abstracts the default inherited from Second.

nodes.name: arrayMembers
nodes.documentation: The members every array has: length is no field and clone() overrides Object.clone().

nodes.name: documented
nodes.documentation: A documented method.

nodes.name: syntax
nodes.documentation: The syntax fixture: one file per topic the parser maps.

nodes.name: Program
nodes.documentation: The entry point: runs the invocation and local-variable forms, joins a future, then exits.

nodes.name: AnnotationUsage
nodes.documentation: Annotations from the own module, the other module, the platform and the Noesis library, with every value kind, on every placement.

nodes.name: GenericMethods
nodes.documentation: Generic methods and their calls: explicit, inferred, varargs.

nodes.name: GenericTypes
nodes.documentation: Generic types: own parameters, inner classes sharing the outer's, bounds, wildcards, raw types.

nodes.name: ImportForms
nodes.documentation: Every import form: on-demand, static, nested types, other module, library, shadowing, and fully qualified names.

nodes.name: Types
nodes.documentation: A class whose simple name differs from the sibling package types only by case.

nodes.name: ClassInDeeplyNestedPackage
nodes.documentation: A class in a deeply dotted package, using a type named like a package segment.

nodes.name: ImportsFromParentPackage
nodes.documentation: A subpackage does not see its parent package: the parent's types need an import or a qualified name.

nodes.name: AbstractInheritance
nodes.documentation: Abstract classes: abstract and template methods, re-abstraction in an intermediate class, a protected base constructor.

nodes.name: ClassInheritance
nodes.documentation: Overriding, covariant returns, constructor chaining, implicit super calls, initializer blocks.

nodes.name: GenericInheritance
nodes.documentation: Generic interfaces implemented with a concrete argument, and an external generic base class from a library (the JDK's own classes change between releases).

nodes.name: NestedDerivedFromGenericOuter
nodes.documentation: An inner class is the only nested kind that can name the outer's T.

nodes.name: LengthConverter
nodes.documentation: An external generic base class from a library: its interface slots are filled by inherited members.

nodes.name: InterfaceInheritance
nodes.documentation: How interface members are satisfied: directly, by a default, by a base class member.

nodes.name: InterfaceImplementation
nodes.documentation: How classes fill interface slots: implicitly, through a base class, across generic, derived, conflicting, other-module and framework interfaces.

nodes.name: InvocationForms
nodes.documentation: Every receiver kind, every body-level fact: calls, accesses, casts, instanceof, creations, lambdas, switches.

nodes.name: InvocationTarget
nodes.documentation: The class every invocation form targets: instance, generic, static, nested and functional members.

nodes.name: InvocationTargets
nodes.documentation: Targets in the own module, the other module, a library and the platform.

nodes.name: VisibilityBridges
nodes.documentation: Calls to public methods a public class inherits from a package-private one. javac gives the public class a bridge for each such method and compiles the calls against the bridge; the model binds them to the inherited method.

nodes.name: DocumentedTypes
nodes.documentation: A documented class with inline code, a link, an entity & and a second paragraph.

nodes.name: Nested
nodes.documentation: Documented nested.

nodes.name: ClassWithFieldsForLocals
nodes.documentation: Fields to assign from a local initializer, with a nested holder for a nested initializer.

nodes.name: DisposableForLocals
nodes.documentation: An AutoCloseable to declare as a try-with-resources resource.

nodes.name: ImmutableArrayLike
nodes.documentation: An own Iterable to drive a for-each loop.

nodes.name: LocalVariableForms
nodes.documentation: Every way a local variable is declared, initialized, assigned or introduced by a statement.

nodes.name: NestedClassForInitializer
nodes.documentation: The nested target of a nested initializer.

nodes.name: FieldDeclarations
nodes.documentation: Fields: every constant kind, modifiers, arrays, initializers that call.

nodes.name: LocalFunctionsAndLambdas
nodes.documentation: Local classes, records, enums and interfaces standing in for local functions, and every lambda form.

nodes.name: MethodDeclarations
nodes.documentation: Methods: every modifier, overloads, varargs, throws, initializer blocks.

nodes.name: ReturnAndParameterTypes
nodes.documentation: Return types, parameter kinds, method modifiers, and methods in utility classes, interfaces and records.

nodes.name: BuiltInAndSpecialTypes
nodes.documentation: Built-in, boxed, array, generic, functional, JDK and nested types as instance fields; anonymous types.

nodes.name: ClassKinds
nodes.documentation: Every kind of class declaration and nesting.

nodes.name: InnerClass
nodes.documentation: A non-static nested class is an inner class: its instances belong to an outer instance.

nodes.name: EnumKinds
nodes.documentation: Enums: plain, with fields and a constructor, with constant bodies, implementing an interface.

nodes.name: FileLocalClass
nodes.documentation: A package-private top-level class in another class's file: the closest mirror of a file-local type.

nodes.name: FileLocalEnum
nodes.documentation: A package-private top-level enum in another class's file.

nodes.name: FileLocalInterface
nodes.documentation: A package-private top-level interface in another class's file.

nodes.name: FileLocalRecord
nodes.documentation: A package-private top-level record in another class's file.

nodes.name: FileLocalStaticClass
nodes.documentation: A package-private utility class creating the file-local types.

nodes.name: FunctionalInterfaceKinds
nodes.documentation: Functional interfaces of every shape, each targeted by a lambda, a method reference or an anonymous class.

nodes.name: InterfaceKinds
nodes.documentation: Interfaces with every member kind, and an annotation type with defaults.

nodes.name: LocalAndAnonymousClasses
nodes.documentation: Classes declared inside a method: local, anonymous, local record.

nodes.name: RecordKinds
nodes.documentation: Records: plain, compact constructor, explicit accessor, generic, implementing an interface.

nodes.name: LibraryTypeUsage
nodes.documentation: The same uses of a type declared in a library; differs from its siblings only in the ids referenced.

nodes.name: OtherModuleTypeUsage
nodes.documentation: The same uses of a type declared in the other module; differs from its siblings only in the ids referenced.

nodes.name: OwnModuleTypeUsage
nodes.documentation: The same uses of a type declared in this module; differs from its siblings only in the ids referenced.

nodes.name: UsedAbstractClass
nodes.documentation: An own-module abstract class: a base to extend and a method to override.

nodes.name: UsedCloseable
nodes.documentation: An own-module resource for try-with-resources.

nodes.name: UsedEnum
nodes.documentation: An own-module enum.

nodes.name: UsedException
nodes.documentation: An own-module exception.

nodes.name: UsedFunction
nodes.documentation: An own-module functional interface.

nodes.name: UsedInterface
nodes.documentation: A non-generic own-module interface.

nodes.name: UsedRecord
nodes.documentation: An own-module record.

nodes.name: UsedType
nodes.documentation: The own-module type every position in OwnModuleTypeUsage refers to.

nodes.name: Nested
nodes.documentation: A nested type of the own-module type, reached by its qualified name.
